name: Ikenai Houkago ~Ookii Oppai de Kare to Tanoshimu~
original_name: イケナイ放課後～大きいおっぱいで彼と楽しむ～
source:
A self-proclaimed witch is locked into a room and has her tits inflated.
She confesses to the guy she likes, but even then her tits are still huge.
So hey, while she's at it, she might as well make use of these enormous things.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ267556.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 一个自称女巫的女孩被锁在房间里，胸部也被胀大。她向喜欢的男生告白，可胸部仍然巨大。既然如此，她不如趁机利用自己的夸张身材。[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ267556.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
